incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: latency-alert - p95 > 2.5s for /v1/generate (us-west-2). Incident INC-2026-045.
alex: acked. I'm oncall, joining.
priya: joining. customer visible?
alex: yes, hosted users seeing p95 spike. error rate low.
juan: no deploys in last 3h. infra changes?
sasha: seeing host-level contextswitch/paging spikes on node-gpu-03. sharing quick perf sample:
```
perf stat -e cpu-clock,context-switches,page-faults -I 1000
# sample output (truncated)
1000, 12450, 890, 45
2000, 13012, 1023, 67
```
alex: copying service logs 12:02-12:12 UTC:
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:05Z] req_id=7f3a latency_ms=1300 trace_id=trace/abc123
[2026-03-17T12:04:12Z] req_id=8a2b latency_ms=2700 trace_id=trace/def456
[2026-03-17T12:05:01Z] req_id=9c4d latency_ms=1800 trace_id=trace/ghi789
```
priya: I sampled traces. KV-cache miss rate jumps at ~12:03. spans show `serve_thread` blocked waiting on page-in. trace ids: trace/abc123, trace/def456.
juan: infra rolled kernel 5.14.11 -> 5.14.13 on some nodes at 08:00. could be related.
sasha: perf counters show increased minor page faults and context switches starting ~12:00 on node-gpu-03.
alex: mitigation: shifting traffic off node-gpu-03 + spin up small warm pool. routing change now.
incident-bot: ROUTE UPDATE: traffic weight node-gpu-03 set 0.1 -> 0.0
priya: enabling extra kv-cache warmup on new hosts and watching p50/p95.
juan: hypotheses: A) kernel scheduler / reclaim heuristics regression affecting tiny page churn; B) noisy neighbor IO triggering pageins.
sasha: can infra grab dmesg + vmstat for node-gpu-03 11:50-12:20?
alex: pasted dmesg excerpt:
```
[12:01:02] INFO: CPU0 softirqs handled
[12:02:59] kernel: swap_pager: page fault minor=123 major=0 from task=serve_thread
[12:03:10] kernel: kswapd0: scanning target=4096 pages
```
priya: adding timeline doc (internal): https://redwood-internal/timeline/INC-2026-045 (will update).
juan: tagging @marta (perf eng) — can you check kernel perf events for reclaim / LRU pressure?
marta: joining. initial read shows pgscan_kswapd spikes and increased reclaim scans 12:00-12:06 on node-gpu-03. looks like reclaim backpressure.
alex: next steps: keep traffic off affected hosts, collect full perf records (perf record -a -g), capture full traces, consider temporary swap disable on node-gpu-03 as probe. handoff to priya at 12:30 if still active.
incident-bot: HANDOFF scheduled to priya at 12:30 UTC
sasha: checklist left in thread:
- perf record (full)
- vmstat /proc/vmstat snapshot
- dmesg full dump
- optional: disable swap on node-gpu-03 (monitor)
- kernel bisect candidate list (if regression confirmed)
priya: ack. I'll take over at 12:30 and coordinate rollback path with infra-ops if we confirm kernel regression.
juan: customer-impact note: ~4% of requests >2s, no increase in 5xx. potential SLA exposure for some hosted customers. updating incident page.
alex: thanks everyone. continuing monitoring and will post updates in timeline. :thumbsup:
